rule_correction: hb-ot-shape.cc 90-91: script_fallback_mark_positioning is the categorized shaper's fallback_position, taken before morx swaps a non-default shaper for dumber (94-96); 192-201: fallback_mark_positioning = adjust_mark_positioning_when_zeroing (no GPOS, no kerx, no kern or no cross-stream kern) && script_fallback_mark_positioning; 207-208 clears only adjust_mark_positioning_when_zeroing for morx.

hb-ot-shape.cc 1118-1120 then runs _hb_ot_shape_fallback_mark_position (hb-ot-shape-fallback.cc 440-462): each base (a glyph whose character is not a Unicode mark Mn/Mc/Me) with the Unicode marks after it is a cluster; position_cluster (412-437) -> position_around_base -> zero_mark_advances (188-205) zeroes every Mn of the cluster (by general category, whatever the glyph class).
Shapers' fallback_position (10.0.1): default, arabic, hebrew true; thai, indic, khmer, myanmar, use, hangul false.

So an unmapped Mn in complex text is zero when (a) its run is default-shaped and the face zeroes marks by GDEF (unchanged), or (b) the face has no GPOS/kerx/cross-stream kern, its run's categorized shaper is default, arabic (Arabic, Syriac) or hebrew, and a non-mark base precedes it in the run with only marks between.
face_fact: Cross-stream kern: Helvetica and Helvetica-Bold have one Apple kern subtable, format 0, coverage bit 0x4000 clear (CoreText table read on colossus, same macOS build and system font file; the round-6 extraction records the format but not the bit). Lucida Grande and Menlo have no kern; faces with GPOS never take the fallback path.
change: tools/font_chain_unicode.py: NONSPACING_MARKS and a new UNICODE_MARKS (Mn, Mc, Me) from UnicodeData 16.0.0; FALLBACK_POSITIONED_SCRIPTS = Arabic, Syriac, Hebrew.

font_chain: Complexity::Complex carries the run's shaper class and whether a base precedes the token in its run; FaceCoverage gains fallback_positions_marks (generated from #hb_plan plus the cross-stream fact).
The base must share the HarfBuzz buffer (script run and font slot run); the port checks the script run only (residue: a base from another slot font).
